title: Integrated Multi-Omics and Single-Cell Analyses Implicate NOX4 as an Icariin-Associated Oxidative Stress Regulatory Node in Gastric Cancer.
snippet: Icariin, a prenylated flavonoid glycoside from Epimedium species, is a representative dietary polyphenol with antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antitumor properties.
